description: XO backup jobs (by type) and XO management-plane / process health. xo-server-openmetrics does not expose backup run status (success/failure/duration) today.

spec.title: Backup Jobs Total
spec.description: Total number of configured backup jobs, all types combined (xo_backup_job_total).

spec.title: Pending Tasks (all XO tasks)
spec.description: xo_task_pending counts ALL pending XO tasks (not backup-specific) — backup jobs run as XO tasks since XO 6.4, so a sustained spike here can indicate stuck/queued jobs, but it is not exclusive to backups.

spec.title: Backup Jobs by Type (trend)
spec.description: Snapshot of configured job counts over time — a step change means a job was added or removed.

spec.title: Heap Usage
spec.description: Approaches 1.0 close to an out-of-memory crash of the XO main process (would abort running backup jobs).

spec.title: Detached V8 Contexts
spec.description: Non-zero and growing indicates a memory leak in the XO process (xo_nodejs_detached_contexts).

spec.title: Hosts by Version
spec.description: Useful to spot pools running an XCP-ng/XenServer version whose backup drivers (NBD, CBT) may differ from the rest of the fleet.

title: Xoa Backup Overview
